{

"title": "Update address records across systems",
"text": "Update Elena Mossbutton’s address to Fort Collins, Colorado across the advisory profile, custodian records, portal delivery settings, IRA records, and Robin Mossbutton’s household contact record once move‑in confirmation is received.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-07-03",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For household address and state-residency record updates, Elena explicitly asked Apricot Compass Advisory to replace the Portland mailing address with the Fort Collins household address across the advisory profile, custodian records, portal delivery settings, IRA records, and Robin’s household contact record once move-in confirmation is available; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-07-03."
},
{
"templateId": "bf1a1f75-ef8b-54cb-9c38-f995512b2662",
"title": "Collect tax documents for planning review",
"text": "Please collect the following tax materials for the planning file:\n\nTax year: [Tax Year]\nClient household or entity: Elena Mossbutton\nCPA or tax preparer contact: Nia Bramblequill at Clockwork Clover Tax\nExpected filing status: [Filing Status]\nDocuments requested: Moonbadger Analytics paystub, Tin Sparrow Learning Cooperative year‑to‑date payroll report, moving reimbursement information, written permission for CPA coordination\nDocuments already received: [Received Items]\nDocuments still outstanding: Moonbadger Analytics paystub, Tin Sparrow Learning Cooperative year‑to‑date payroll report, moving reimbursement information, written permission for CPA coordination\nSecure upload location or delivery method: [Secure Upload Method]\nSpecial planning questions to review: [Questions]\nPermission to coordinate with tax preparer: Yes\n\nElena Mossbutton needs these cross‑state tax planning materials to complete the advisory file before the July 11 deadline.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-07-11",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For cross-state tax planning materials, the planning file does not yet include Elena’s latest Moonbadger Analytics paystub, Robin’s Tin Sparrow Learning Cooperative year-to-date payroll report, moving reimbursement information, or written permission for Nia Bramblequill at Clockwork Clover Tax to coordinate with the advisory team; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-07-11."
},
{
"templateId": "bd12f883-8acf-5b18-99ca-5dc82f67b3c8",
"title": "Coordinate custodian transfer tracking",
"text": "Track a custodian transfer through each handoff point, including paperwork status, sending‑firm release, receiving‑firm receipt, asset reconciliation, and client communication. Use placeholders for account names and transfer identifiers; do not store full account numbers in the template. Prepare and submit the transfer package for Elena Mossbutton’s taxable brokerage account from Paper Otter Wealth to Velvet Acorn Custody.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-07-18",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Prepare and verify transfer package",
"text": "Confirm transfer form completeness, registration match, delivery method, and any statement or acceptance paperwork required before submission.",
"priority": "high",
"assigneeId": "c089d7f5-dba5-5cf9-bafe-c7fb83348936"
},
{
"title": "Submit to receiving custodian and record tracking details",
"text": "Send the transfer package through the approved channel and record the submission confirmation, transfer type, and expected status checkpoints using placeholders.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "c089d7f5-dba5-5cf9-bafe-c7fb83348936"
},
{
"title": "Monitor external release and resolve exceptions",
"text": "Follow up on pending, rejected, or partial transfer statuses; document any required corrected paperwork, liquidation instruction, or contra‑firm requirement.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": null
},
{
"title": "Reconcile assets and communicate completion",
"text": "Compare received assets and cash to the prior statement, flag residual sweeps or missing positions, and prepare a completion update for the client record.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "c089d7f5-dba5-5cf9-bafe-c7fb83348936"
}
],
"evidence": "For the brokerage transfer from the former provider, Elena reported that Paper Otter Wealth sent two account notices to the former Portland address after mail forwarding began and that its service desk could not confirm corrected delivery settings; the agreed work covers a transfer package for the taxable brokerage to Velvet Acorn Custody, due 2025-07-18."
},
{
"templateId": "7e5df057-b6d6-59e3-b7ef-4b6f7ca3a27c",
"title": "Collect Mortgage Document Packet",
"text": "Collect the required brokerage, retirement, bank, and insurance statements for Elena Mossbutton’s Fort Collins mortgage application, ensuring no full account numbers are transmitted via email, and assemble them into the advisory record for the lender.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-06-30",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the Fort Collins mortgage packet, the townhouse lender asked for recent brokerage, retirement, bank, and insurance statements before underwriting can finish, and Elena wants the advisory record used to assemble the financial packet without sending full account numbers by email; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-30."
},
{
"templateId": "f4c9cebf-44bc-53c4-8301-3d3ac2e2e7cf",
"title": "Review insurance policies on a recurring cadence",
"text": "Every year, review each relevant insurance policy for coverage amount, premium status, ownership, beneficiary designations, cash value or loan activity if applicable, policy performance, and continued fit with the client’s financial plan. Note any changes in family status, retirement income needs, estate planning goals, or tax considerations that may require carrier or attorney coordination.\n\nCompare Elena Mossbutton’s Silver Marmot Insurance policies and provider list against the new Fort Collins household setup, updating residence, vehicle garaging location, local medical network, and emergency contacts.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-07-25",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the insurance and provider transition review, the relocation changes the insured residence, vehicle garaging location, local medical network, and emergency contacts, and Elena wants her Silver Marmot Insurance policies and provider list compared against the Fort Collins household setup; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-07-25."
},
{
"templateId": "a9d3b8a3-fcdf-5a99-bb86-dc976b2554d7",
"title": "Complete beneficiary update checklist",
"text": "Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates:\n\n- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review.\n- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.\n- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.\n- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.\n- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.\n- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer‑on‑death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.\n- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.\n- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.\n- Note any estate planning follow‑up needed with the client’s attorney.\n\nConduct a consolidated review of Elena Mossbutton’s beneficiary records for the IRA, taxable transfer‑on‑death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy, and coordinate with the attorney to update successor contacts as needed.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2025-08-08",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For beneficiary and estate-document alignment, Mira’s relocation review found that the IRA, taxable transfer-on-death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy still reference the Oregon trust documents and Lara Thimblefern as successor contact; the agreed follow-up is a consolidated review of household beneficiary records and attorney coordination notes, due 2025-08-08."
}
]
}
